mapper.select: SELECT APPLICANT_RECORD_NO , RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO , APPLICANT_ID , RECRUIT_PROCESS_STEP , STEP_PASS_YN , STEP_APPLICATION_YN FROM APPLICANT_RECORD

SELECT APPLICANT_RECORD_NO , RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO , APPLICANT_ID , STEP_PASS_YN , STEP_APPLICATION_YN , INTERVIEW_URL , EVALUATION_START_TIME , APPLICANT_NAME FROM APPLICANT_RECORD WHERE APPLICANT_RECORD_NO = #{applicantRecordNo}

SELECT rp.RECRUITMENT_NO AS recruitment_no, -- 공고 PK rp.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO AS process_no, rp.RECRUIT_PROCESS_STEP AS step, rp.RECRUIT_PROCESS_TYPE AS step_type, rp.RECRUIT_PROCESS_FINAL as final, ar.APPLICANT_ID AS applicant_id, ar.APPLICANT_NAME AS applicant_name, ar.STEP_APPLICATION_YN AS attend, ar.STEP_PASS_YN AS pass, ap.USER_ID as userid, re.RESUME_NO as resumeurl, ans.APPLICANT_SCORE AS exam_score, iscore.APPLICANT_RATING AS interview_score FROM RECRUIT_PROCESS rp LEFT JOIN APPLICANT_RECORD ar ON rp.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO = ar.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO LEFT JOIN APPLICANT ap ON ap.APPLICANT_ID = ar.APPLICANT_ID LEFT JOIN RESUME re ON re.RESUME_NO = ap.RESUME_NO LEFT JOIN APPLICANT_ANSWER ans ON ans.APPLICANT_ID = ar.APPLICANT_ID AND ans.RECRUIT_EXAM_NO = rp.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO LEFT JOIN INTERVIEW_SCORE iscore ON iscore.APPLICANT_ID = ar.APPLICANT_ID AND iscore.INTERVIEW_NO = rp.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO WHERE rp.RECRUITMENT_NO = #{recruitmentNo} ORDER BY step, applicant_id

SELECT APPLICANT_RECORD_NO , RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO , APPLICANT_ID , STEP_PASS_YN , STEP_APPLICATION_YN , INTERVIEW_URL , EVALUATION_START_TIME , APPLICANT_NAME FROM APPLICANT_RECORD WHERE APPLICANT_ID = #{applicantId} AND RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO = #{recruitProcessNo}
